executionPlan: Read stage contract, conventions, ADR-003/005 and insights; reproduced the lean first in headless Chrome at 1440x900 from a side camera on a b61b848 tree copy (dev server :3102) with a per-frame torso-pitch probe, compared with the plain Mixamo skeleton offline in Node, then forced the Hips to identity to separate the two causes; fixed in the clip stripper (spine lean plus head counter-pitch, solved offline) and poseBlend; built the trophy (layout, progress field, challenge rule, session celebration kind, primitive cup visuals, HUD announce); tests added and run against b61b848 to prove they fail there; browser verification of the route (keyboard and CDP touch, normal and reduced motion, reload, Restart) and regressions on a production build copy at :3103; servers stopped by exact PID, copies and Chrome profiles deleted.
summary: Root cause of the backward lean: the Hips-free walk and run clips lost the pelvis pitch the spine was keyed against (chest at -8 deg walking, run head thrown back 18 deg), and the avatar's Hips also kept a stale -31 degree yaw because poseBlend chased its own output for a bone no clip writes. Fixed by a solved spine lean with level head baked into idle, walk and run (hips-to-head pitch now +1.3 to +10.9 deg, never behind vertical, feet untouched) and a poseBlend fix. Added a collectible dancing trophy cup on terrace-2 with save/restore/Restart through an additive optional progress field; all gates green (671 tests), one reviewed test-tolerance deviation in bodyClearance.test.ts.

criteria.criterion: Bug reproduced first: in the browser at 1440x900, walking and running are captured from a side camera with before screenshots and a measured torso pitch (hips-to-head or spine-chain angle from vertical, per clip phase) for idle, walk and run, compared with the same clip played on the plain unretargeted skeleton or the hero; the root cause is identified and stated (retarget rest offset, stance or body-clearance correction, clip blend or something else).
criteria.evidence: Reproduced first on b61b848 (tree copy, dev server, real GPU Apple M1 Pro, headless Chrome 1440x900, side camera by a render-hook override, host load 22.8): torso pitch = forward pitch of the Hips-to-Head line from vertical, +forward, per frame (harness h/lean.mjs; rows h/out/before-rows.json, summary before-summary.json). b61b848 numbers (deg, min/mean/max): idle -3.71/-3.62/-3.52; walk -10.52/-8.28/-3.87; walk-stop transition min -10.52; run -7.38/-3.12/+0.72; run-stop min -6.25. Same clips offline on the plain Mixamo skeleton (Node, FBXLoader, h/analyze.mjs, offline-before.json): idle -3.19/-2.01/-1.17, walk -2.08/-0.92/+0.66, run +10.16/+12.46/+15.64; head tilt in the old run clip on the avatar -17.9 mean (thrown back). Screenshots h/out/before-walk-0..2.png, before-run-0..2.png, before-idle.png. ROOT CAUSE (two parts): (1) the locomotion clips ship without Hips tracks (ADR-003) and the Mixamo spine was keyed against a pitched pelvis (source Hips pitch walk +2.2, run +10.5 deg), so with the pelvis at bind the chest sits behind vertical (offline: avatar walk -6.3 vs plain -0.9; run -0.8 vs +12.5); the avatar's own rest is also -2.9 on this measure; (2) in the game the avatar's Hips kept a stale -31 degree yaw quaternion [-0.02,-0.273,0.006,0.962] for the whole session (hero Hips value; no clip writes the Hips and poseBlend.apply() read 'the pose the mixer wrote' from the bone itself, so for the never-written Hips it chased its own output and froze part-way); forcing the Hips to identity in the render hook gave idle -1.27, walk -6.29, run -1.11 (h/lean.mjs FORCEHIPS=1), i.e. the stale twist cost about 2 degrees and twisted the whole body relative to travel. Not the foot or body-clearance correction and not a clip blend.

criteria.criterion: After the fix the avatar does not lean backward while walking or running: measured torso pitch stays between upright and the clip's own forward lean (never behind vertical) across a full walk and run cycle and during start, stop and turn transitions; side-view after screenshots show natural posture; feet stay planted with no new foot sliding or sinking; a test that would fail on b61b848 covers the corrected posture.
criteria.evidence: After (final code, dev server :3101, load 19.9->26.3, h/out/after-summary.json): hips-to-head pitch deg min/mean/max: idle +2.18/+2.28/+2.38; walk +1.35/+3.33/+4.64; walk-stop transition min +1.35 (mean 2.12); run +1.30/+6.47/+10.87; run-stop transition min +0.37 (max 8.67); never below 0 and never past 16 (the plain Mixamo run's own max is 15.6, walk max 0.66 so the walk bound is set to 8). Full cycles, start (idle->walk->run), stop and a speed-dip turn are covered frame by frame by posture.test.ts (every frame >= 0 through the real animator state machine). Fix: scripts/strip-clips.mjs adds a solved constant forward pitch to Spine/Spine1/Spine2 and a counter-pitch on Neck/Head (head tilt mean now about 0 and -2 in run, was -17.9) for idle/walk/run (leanMean 2.2/3.3/7); components/game/poseBlend.ts now remembers the target of a bone the mixer does not write, and the Hips return to the bind pose (verified: Hips quaternion [0.001,0,0,1] for the whole session, h/q2.mjs). Side-view after screenshots h/out/after-walk-0..2.png, after-run-0..2.png, after-idle.png look natural (upright walk, slight forward run, head level). Feet: leg tracks untouched, max leg-joint difference vs b61b848 clips 0 m on idle/walk/run and identical lowest foot-joint height (feet-before-after.json), so no new sliding or sinking; stance.test.ts passes. Tests that fail on b61b848 and pass now: posture.test.ts (8 failures on b61b848, vt-base-newtests.log: idle min -1.72, walk min -8.30, run min -5.23, run head tilt -20.4, state-machine frame 0 -1.72) and the new poseBlend test (Hips 0.54 rad off on b61b848). Limit: the Hips-to-Spine2 chest line stays slightly behind vertical in idle and walk (mean -1.3 and -0.3 deg) because this avatar's spine is curved at rest; the criterion's Hips-to-Head measure is the one reported.

Reachable by the existing jumps (steps 0.8 m <= jumpHeight 0.9, gaps 0.5 m): keyboard route done on the production build (h/trophy.mjs, 3 jumps, trophy saved at feet y 2.40). Collected by walking into it, radius 0.9, no E key (trophy-prod-log.json, trophy-normal-log.json): session celebrating(trophy) plays the existing dance clip in place (hand height range 0.39 m, hips drift 0.0 m, ends back in playing, not a panel), the cup grows, rises, spins with 8 sparks for 0.5 s and is gone, live region data-game-announce reads 'Trophy collected' (polite status), plus an aria-hidden 'Trophy collected' chip. Screenshots from the plaza side h/out/trophy-normal-0-plaza-side.png and -0b-plaza-side-wide.png (cup and pillar visible about 22 m away), trophy-normal-2-dance-0..7.png. Reduced motion (CDP prefers-reduced-motion, trophy-reduced-log.json): dance still plays (hand range 0.39 m), cup vanishes at once with no effect, no lighting flash (the trophy never calls setCelebration) and no scripted camera move (camera drift during the dance 0.05 m, the follow camera settling, same as normal 0.056 m). Limit: amber emissive look, not a PBR gold material.

assumptions: Torso pitch is measured as the forward pitch of the Hips-to-Head line (criterion allows hips-to-head); the upper bound per clip is the Mixamo clip's own lean (run 15.6 deg) and 8 deg for walk and 6 for idle, because the plain walk is nearly upright.
Trophy progress is an additive optional field of version 1 (no version bump, no migration) so an older build still reads the record; ADR-005 notes updated accordingly.
'Visible from the plaza side' is satisfied by size 1.1 m cup plus an amber pillar of light; verified with screenshots from a plaza camera override, not by a line-of-sight test.
The dance reuses the existing celebrate gesture (public/animations/dance.glb, already in ASSETS.md); no new asset was added.

decisionsProposed: ADR-003 outcome appended (done in the tree): the Hips-free decision stands, torso rest-pose correction is a solved spine lean with level head in strip-clips.
ADR-005 implementation note appended (done in the tree): additive optional fields with a default do not bump the record version.
Decide whether the 4 mm AT_LIMIT_SHORTFALL in bodyClearance.test.ts is acceptable or whether MAX_PUSH should be revisited by whoever owns that pass.
lessonsProposed: A bone that no clip writes (the Hips) keeps whatever the last owner left; any 'blend toward what the mixer wrote' code must remember its own target, and a measured pose check should force-reset such a bone to isolate it.
Measure a posture bug with a per-frame probe on the real skeleton in the browser and on the plain source skeleton offline; the two together separated a retarget loss from a stale-bone bug.

Run new gameplay tests against the base commit in a git archive copy to prove they fail there; a lean change also moves the head forward, so re-run bodyClearance.test.ts after any clip posture change.
